description: This file defines a test support class 'Workflow' used for automating UI interactions in acceptance testing of the Workflow management feature within the SuiteCRM project. It contains methods for navigating to the workflow page, selecting modules, adding conditions, and setting condition parameters.

classes.name: Workflow
classes.description: A support class for acceptance testing that interacts with the Workflow management UI in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: navigateToWorkflow
methods.description: Navigates to the Workflow management page in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: selectWorkflowModule
methods.description: Selects a specific module in the workflow configuration page.

methods.name: addCondition
methods.description: Adds a new condition row in the workflow settings.

methods.name: setConditionModuleField
methods.description: Sets the module and field for a specific condition row.

methods.name: setConditionOperator
methods.description: Sets the operator and value type for a specific condition row.

methods.name: setConditionOperatorDateTimeValue
methods.description: Sets a date/time value for a condition using a calendar dialog.

methods.name: getLastConditionRowNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the number of the last condition row.
